grading_system.evidence: All students graduating in the class of 2020 and beyond must accumulate a minimum of 24 credits, maintain their Personalized Learning Plan, and demonstrate evidence of proficiency in the areas listed below.

schedule.evidence: At the end of each semester (January and June) academic progress will be calculated as a final grade. Full-time: traditional courses or other experiences equivalent to at least 4 credits per school year (p.4-5).

credit_definition.text: A full-year course earns one credit, a half-year course one-half credit.
credit_definition.evidence: A full-year course earns one credit, a half-year course, one-half credit.

course_load.min_courses_or_credits: equivalent to at least 4 credits per school year to be full-time (Classes of 2022 and beyond)
course_load.evidence: to be considered a full-time student at FHUMHS, students in grades 9-12 should be enrolled in traditional courses or other educational experiences ... equivalent to at least 4 credits per school year.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Already in standard credits (1 = full-year course, per p.5). Subject minimums: English Language Arts & Literacy 4, Mathematics 3, Science 3, Global Citizenship 3 (must include U.S. History), Additional Core Flex 1, Physical Education 1.5, Health .5, Arts 1 (Music or Visual Arts), Electives 7. Beginning with the Class of 2030, 14 core credits are required, including a Flex credit (ELA, Math, Science or Social Studies) (p.5).

flexible_pathways_listed: Personal Learning Plans (PLP) defining how proficiency is shown when a pathway replaces core experiences
Academic concentrations: Global Humanities and Quantitative Literacy
notes: Current catalog is 2026-27. Requirements are 24 credits, a PLP, and proficiency evidence (p.5); the catalog says the school 'will continue to track credits' alongside proficiencies. Latin honors use a Proficiency-Based Scoring Average (Summa 3.75, Magna 3.50, Cum Laude 3.25) (p.14); the scale's maximum is not stated. Co-curricular eligibility requires an average proficiency score of at least 2.5 in each class and transferable skill, which is not a graduation rule (p.16). Weighted course levels are Advanced (6), Honors (5), General (4) for GPA purposes only (p.5-6). Full-time status is stated as 4 credits per school year, not as a course count. The catalog says each class meets for 'periods' (e.g., a 3-period outdoor pursuits course), but the number of periods per day is not stated, so schedule.type is traditional periods and courses_per_term is null. The Transferable Skills (five) are listed (p.10), but the catalog does not state them as a graduation requirement, so transferable_skills_required is null. Physical education: 1.5 credits, at least 30 minutes of physical activity offered daily (p.10).
